desc: Read the input values $N$, $R$, $C$, and the string $S$.
Implement the $O(N)$ solution using prefix sums and a hash set to track valid offsets.
Precompute the prefix sum array $P$ where $P_t$ is the position of the initial smoke after $t$ steps.
Check if $(R, C)$ is present by verifying if $P_t - (R, C)$ exists in the set of valid previous offsets.
Update the set of valid offsets for the next iteration (add $P_t$ if $P_{t+1} \neq (0,0)$).
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Ensure edge cases (e.g., $N=1$, smoke returning to origin) are handled correctly by the logic.
Confirm output format matches exactly (string of 0s and 1s).
